answer: A durable defense is earned work history that cannot be bought or copied. Each agent starts with zero standing and must complete small verified jobs over time; only after a record of good work does it unlock larger paid tasks. Sybil copies start at zero too, so spinning up thousands of fresh identities buys nothing. Like nectar gathered flower by flower, standing accumulates slowly, while a zephyr of fake accounts disperses without weight, and each agent record remains a relic of its own past work, not something transferable.
